title: The Town Hall We Deserve: An Evening with Rep. Sara Jacobs

Join Indivisible North County San Diego and our powerful coalition of regional grassroots groups for a dynamic, people-powered congressional town hall—the kind Representative Darrell Issa refuses to hold.

In 2025, many Republican House members—including Issa—are dodging public accountability. They’re avoiding traditional town halls because they don’t want to answer tough questions about their voting records, their ties to extremist policies, and their refusal to represent the will of their constituents. title: Sign the Petition for SB1 Referendum in Delphos
description:
We'll be at Stadium Park in Delphos with the Van Wert Dems to collect signatures for the referendum on SB1. 

## WHAT IS SENATE BILL 1?

- Senate Bill 1  (“The Higher Education Destruction Act”) was signed into OH law by Gov. DeWine on March 28, 2025 and goes into effect on June 25, 2025. 
- SB1 guts collective bargaining rights for faculty unions, removes job protections for educators & bans striking time for full-time staff.
- SB1 allows colleges & universities to end programs & terminate faculty positions without warning or cause.
- SB1 bans most diversity, equity & inclusion programs and staff training in higher education.
- We have until June 22 to collect 250,000 signatures in OH and get a repeal measure on the Nov. ballot.
- Republicans in OH leadership have now introduced bills (SB113 & HB155) targeted at grades K-12. We must stop attacks on public education!
- For more information, visit [ohiosb1petition.com](ohiosb1petition.com)
- Sign the petition to repeal SB1!

#### Sorting Soup: Turning Ideas Into Action - Join Weekly - every Tuesday & Thursday,  Zoom @4PM central

_Feeling overwhelmed by the constant stream of ideas, strategies, and information in the pro-democracy movement? You’re not alone._

That’s why we created Sorting Soup—a twice-weekly space to process, connect, and turn information into real-world impact. Inspired by the dynamic NWSOFA 9am Coffee & Conversation network, Sorting Soup is your opportunity to ground yourself, build community, and decide what’s truly worth your time and energy.

#### Let us know you will be attending … RSVP here-> https://mobilize.us/s/1162kb

Join us every Tuesday and Thursday at 4 PM (CST), starting June 10th. title: Protect Home Rule: Postcarding Party
description:
# JOIN OUR 2nd POSTCARD PARTY! ✍️📬

**Help Congress Understand What Home Rule Means to DC Residents**

Are you frustrated with Congress interfering in DC's local affairs? Turn that energy into action! Join us for a "Future Constituent" Postcard Party where you can document your DC concerns and suggestions that will be delivered directly to congressional offices.

## What We're Doing 🗣️
We're creating postcards addressed to members of Congress from their "future constituents" (that's us!) to help them understand what they'd be responsible for if they repeal Home Rule:
* Fixing your neighborhood potholes
* Handling trash collection complaints
* Managing local park maintenance
* Resolving parking disputes
* Addressing school funding issues

## Why It Works 💡
During our recent congressional visits, these postcards sparked meaningful conversations with staffers who suddenly realized the burden of managing local DC issues. As one participant noted: "It creates a starting point for dialogue about what repealing Home Rule would actually mean for them."

## Join Us! 📅
* **When**: Wednesday, June 18th, 6:00-8:00 PM
* **Where**: Women's National Democratic Club in Dupont Circle. We will be joining the existing Winning Wednesdays action nights at this lovely venue!
* **Materials**: All provided - just bring your DC experiences!
* **Context**: We will kick off with a brief Home Rule 101 and are available for Q&A anytime!
* **Impact**: Your postcards will be hand-delivered during our weekly congressional visits

Can't make this event? Contact us about hosting your own postcard party with friends, neighbors, or colleagues!

Remember: "This is a marathon, not a sprint" - and your voice matters in this fight for DC's autonomy!

title: PA District 7 Budget Bill Town Hall
description:
Hello Neighbor!

Join us at our next Town Hall on Tuesday, June 17th at 6:30pm!

We’ve invited our Congressman, Ryan Mackenzie, to come and explain why he voted YAY to cut Medicaid and SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) — even though just a few months ago, he told us he wouldn’t support these cuts.

So far, he hasn’t confirmed. But whether he shows up or not, we’ll be there to speak out and stand together. Do you want to speak at the event to share how these cuts will affect you or a loved one directly? Contact us to tell your story! (click Contact Organization below)

Congressman Mackenzie works for us, the people of Pennsylvania District 7 — not for Trump and his millionaire cronies.

Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” slashes at least $700 billion from healthcare, cutting coverage for nearly 15 million people. It also cuts $300 billion from SNAP, a reduction that could seriously increase food insecurity, especially for low-income families, seniors, and people with disabilities. Meanwhile, providing a tax break to those making $500,000 or more a year!

Stand with us as we hold Ryan Mackenzie accountable for supporting a bill that could devastate the lives of our friends and neighbors here in PA District 7!

Monthly Meeting – Join Us on Zoom!

Mark your calendar for our Monthly Meetings held virtually on the third Wednesday of each month from 7:00–8:30 PM.

Each meeting is packed with value:

-Hot topics and speakers on issues that matter

-Leadership updates to keep you in the loop

-Breakout rooms to connect and network with fellow members

-Action items so you can make a difference


Whether you’re a long-time member or brand new, these meetings are your chance to stay informed, get involved, and be part of the conversation — all from the comfort of your home.

Don’t miss out — we hope to see you there!

description:

We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.

Check out nokings.org for more information.
